essential: You play a small knight in a 2D cave platformer and explore to find the way onward. Each decision plays 0.43 seconds; the game waits while you decide. Answer both questions every time: the movement keys and the attack key. Rules a player learns: a room is left through an opening at its border, and the way can lead up, down, left or right. A long jump rises 5.6 units, or 7 when it is held for two decisions in a row; a short jump rises 1.7. Enemies and spikes hurt on touch and take one mask; with no masks left the knight dies. A sword strike reaches about 2 units, needs 0.4 seconds between strikes, and each hit on an enemy fills some SOUL. Holding focus on the ground for about 1.2 seconds turns a third of the SOUL into one mask. Some doors and walls break when struck. Distances are in units; the knight is 0.5 wide and 1.3 tall. Each option starts with what it leads to. Movement: WALK, LAND, AIR (still in the air after this decision; 'then' lists, top to bottom and in whole units, the places you can still land on by holding or letting go of these keys at the next decisions; '+N more' when not all fit), STAY, WALL (blocked), HURT (you lose a mask), UNSEEN (out of what you have seen), NEW PLACE (you have not stood there) or SEEN and how many times you stood there. Attack: HIT, MISS, NOT READY, NO EFFECT, HEAL, NO KEY. After a place you have stood on, a sideways option may add what lies further that way on this floor: 'new ground N further' (the nearest part you have not stood on), 'not seen beyond N', or that all is seen up to a wall or an edge.
Now: Health 5 of 5 masks. SOUL 0.00. You stand on the ground, facing left.
On screen: Ground: left: open ground for 12+; right: open ground for 12+. No enemy on screen.
The sword is ready.
Memory: You have stood at this spot once before. Places stood on in this room: 1.
